title: Deutsche Bank named Best Asia FX NDF House and FX House of the Year - South Korea
summary: Deutsche Bank named Best Asia FX NDF House and FX House of the Year - South Korea
body_markdown:
Deutsche Bank has won Best Asia FX Non-Deliverable Forwards (NDF) House and for the second consecutive year, FX House of the Year for South Korea. The awards reflect the bank’s leadership in helping clients navigate Asia’s evolving markets with innovation and market expertise and a strong focus on client solutions.


## Best Asia FX Non-Deliverable Forwards (NDF) House


The Best Asia FX Non-Deliverable Forwards (NDF) House award recognises Deutsche Bank’s leadership in providing solutions that help clients manage currency risk across emerging Asian markets. Over the past year, the bank expanded clients’ access to liquidity, increased automation and streamlined execution processes, making it easier for clients to manage risk efficiently.


## FX House of the Year - South Korea


The FX House of the Year – South Korea award for the second year running, acknowledges Deutsche Bank’s role in supporting the internationalisation of Korea’s foreign exchange market. As the country continues to open its financial markets to global investors, the bank has worked closely with clients, regulators and market participants to help shape and support that transition.


## Why Deutsche Bank was recognised as a leader in Asian FX Markets


Asia’s foreign exchange markets are becoming increasingly digital, interconnected and internationally focused. Clients today want more than market access – they want simpler processes, greater transparency and solutions that fit seamlessly into the way they work.


Deutsche Bank has excelled by combining its strong regional network with advanced technology and local expertise. Key initiatives include:


- Investing in Technology: Deutsche Bank enhanced its electronic execution capabilities and integrated solutions to boost efficiency.
- Supporting Korean Market Reforms: The bank expanded its Registered Financial Institution (RFI) presence and invested in local infrastructure, helping clients access deliverable Korean won (KRW) hedging more effectively.
- Building Trusted Partnerships: Deutsche Bank cultivated strong relationships with clients, regulators, and market participants across the region.


<To highlight within a quote box>


> Across both the NDF and South Korea businesses, we have continued to invest in people, technology and infrastructure so that clients can access liquidity, manage risk and execute strategies with greater efficiency and confidence. Ashok Das, Head of Global Emerging Markets & FIC Macro Trading for Asia.


“The awards are a testament to the dedication of our teams across the region and the trusted partnerships we have built with clients, regulators and market participants.” added Ashok.


Both awards reinforce Deutsche Bank’s position as a leading FX partner in Asia at a time when the region’s currency markets are undergoing significant transformation. From helping shape the future of Korea’s FX market to enhancing how clients manage currency risk across Asia, the bank continues to support clients with innovative and practical solutions.
